I can see there's a PowerPoint file called `quarterly_review.pptx`. Let me extract the text content from it. I'll write a Python script to read and extract the text from the presentation.

```python
python3 << 'EOF'
import subprocess
import sys

# First, try to install python-pptx if not already available
subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "python-pptx", "-q"])

from pptx import Presentation

# Load the presentation
prs = Presentation('/workspace/quarterly_review.pptx')

# Extract text from all slides
print("=" * 60)
print("TEXT CONTENT FROM POWERPOINT PRESENTATION")
print("=" * 60)

for i, slide in enumerate(prs.slides):
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"SLIDE {i+1}")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    
    # Get title
    title = slide.shapes.title.text if slide.shapes.title else "No title"
    print(f"\n► Title: {title}")
    
    # Get content from shapes
    print("\n• Content:")
    for shape in slide.shapes:
        if hasattr(shape, "text") and shape != slide.shapes.title:
            text = shape.text.strip()
            if text:
                print(f"    - {text}")
        # Also check for tables
        if hasattr(shape, 'table'):
            print(f"    - Table with {len(shape.table.rows)} rows")
            for row in shape.table.rows:
                cells = [cell.text.strip() for cell in row.cells if cell.text.strip()]
                if cells:
                    print(f"        {', '.join(cells)}")

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("END OF PRESENTATION")
print("=" * 60)
EOF
```

```bash
import subprocess
import sys

# Install python-pptx
subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "python-pptx", "-q"])

from pptx import Presentation

# Load the presentation
prs = Presentation('/workspace/quarterly_review.pptx')

# Extract text from all slides
print("=" * 60)
print("TEXT CONTENT FROM POWERPOINT PRESENTATION")
print("=" * 60)

for i, slide in enumerate(prs.slides):
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"SLIDE {i+1}")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    
    # Get title
    title = slide.shapes.title.text if slide.shapes.title else "No title"
    print(f"\n► Title: {title}")
    
    # Get content from shapes
    print("\n• Content:")
    for shape in slide.shapes:
        if hasattr(shape, "text") and shape != slide.shapes.title:
            text = shape.text.strip()
            if text:
                print(f"    - {text}")
        # Also check for tables
        if hasattr(shape, 'table'):
            for row in shape.table.rows:
                cells = [cell.text.strip() for cell in row.cells if cell.text.strip()]
                if cells:
                    print(f"        {' | '.join(cells)}")

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("END OF PRESENTATION")
print("=" * 60)
EOF
```
